mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo (title, content, member_id, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content},#{memberId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.member_id AS memberId, p.created_at AS createdAt, /* 자식 테이블(file)에서 해당 게시글의 첫 번째 파일명을 가져와 savedName에 대입 */ (SELECT f.saved_name FROM file f WHERE f.photo_id = p.id LIMIT 1) AS savedName FROM photo p ORDER BY p.id DESC
